Extracts article:published_time, modified_time, author, section, and tags

```elixir title="Elixir"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.article.published_time)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.article.modified_time)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.article.author)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.article.section)
```
